title: Breaking the Wolves
summary: The wolves come in waves: howling closer every night. Blythe Fletcher wants the first wave broken and then the second, with a word between them.
offer_text: "It is not one pack, it is two nights of them, howling closer every night. Break the first and come and tell me. Then we finish it."
turn_in_text: "That is two waves broken. I will not say it is over, but I will say it is quiet."

objectives.text: Tell Blythe Fletcher the first are down
Kill 2 more wolves at the edge
Tell Blythe Fletcher the edge is clear

relationship.label: Held the line against the wolves
